messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: Elevated streaming 5xx and premature disconnects detected across gateway -> fanout path. Error rate spike starts ~3759871100, current 5xx ~12% on streaming endpoints, timeout retries spiking. Auto-escalation to SEV2.
ops-bot: Alert: increased 502/504 from gateway tier. Recent deploy? last deploy id: b3f9a2c to gateway at 3759869000.
emma (oncall): I'm on it. Acknowledging pager, starting triage. Can someone post high-level impact? which customers/sdks? :coffee:
sara (support): Quick CS feed: customers reporting truncated streams, repeated "connection reset" in client logs. So far 7 distinct orgs reported issues, 2 on Dedicated, 5 on Hosted. No data loss reported, just incomplete/early EOF.
lina (sre): Looking at metrics: fanout pod restarts correlated with spikes; streaming connection queue depth jumping and long tail latencies. Kernel epoll wait counts elevated on a subset of gateway instances.
ken (eng-runtime): From runtime side, model-worker logs show a backlog and increased gRPC stream cancels from gateway: snippet: ```ERROR model-worker: stream cancelled by client (code=1) payload=null
WARN kv-cache: lookup timeout 200ms exceeded for prefix key=usr:ctx:...```
dave (product): Any sign this is a config regression (timeouts reduced) vs infra saturation? Customers say it started around 09:18 UTC.
emma (oncall): I rolled to recent gateway deploy at 09:10 (b3f9a2c) but that was 35m before reports. Lina, can you confirm if errors align to that deploy?
lina (sre): Correlation isn't perfect: first small bump at 09:12, big spike at 09:18. There are gateway instances in us-west-2 with CPU and epoll backlog growth; but also a handful of model-worker pods showing increased GC pauses on older nodes.
ken (eng-runtime): Hypothesis: combination of connection backlog at gateway + model-worker response slowness -> client timeouts and chunked stream resets. Trying to reproduce locally with fanout load script.
emma (oncall): Immediate mitigation plan: 1) enable gateway failover routing to standby region for new streams, 2) scale up streaming fanout replicas in affected AZ, 3) increase upstream timeouts slightly to avoid premature cancel. I'll run steps 1+2.
emma (oncall): Command I'm executing: ```kubectl scale deployment gate-stream -n prod --replicas=30 --selector=region=us-west-2``` turning on region fallback in routing config: ```redwood-routing set-policy streaming fallback_regions=[us-east-1]```
ops-bot: Executed: scaled gate-stream from 18 -> 30 replicas. Routing policy updated to add fallback region.
qa-bot: Note: enabling fallback may increase latency for some sessions; observability dashboards updated with fallback tag.
sara (support): Notifying top impacted customers with status: investigating; workaround: retry stream with small backoff, some clients saw successful reconnects. Sending CS template now.
dave (product): Keep product notified if SLAs at risk; add top-3 customers to incident notes.
ken (eng-runtime): Observability after scale+fallback: error rate dropped from 12% -> 4% over 6m, but a residual class of disconnects persists tied to chunked-encoding trailer corruption on a small percent of requests. Logs show partial frames plus client cancel: ```WARN gateway: client canceled mid-chunk, connection close: ECONNRESET```
lina (sre): I'm seeing a misbehaving proxy pod that shows OOM killer events around 09:17 on two hosts, causing brief reconnect storms. Evicting and re-scheduling to newer hosts. Also draining two old nodes.
emma (oncall): Evictions done. Rolling restart of proxy group in us-west-2 to clear potential kernel TCP state: ```for pod in $(kubectl get pods -l app=proxy -n prod -o name); do kubectl rollout restart $pod; done```
incident-bot: New event: proxy restart completed on 6/6 pods in us-west-2.
ken (eng-runtime): After evictions + restarts, residual checksum/trailer errors are lower. Investigating client library behavior: some older clients do not handle partial chunk frames gracefully and issue immediate cancel leading to 5xx mapping on our gateway.
sara (support): Cross-check: affected customers using SDK versions <= 0.9.1. We have a compatibility note and a recommended SDK upgrade to 1.0.2 that handles mid-chunk reconnects. Pushing patch notes to customers.
emma (oncall): For live mitigation, we've enabled a temporary lenient parser on gateway to accept partial frames and avoid mapping them to 5xx for a 1-hour window: ```feature-toggle gateway.partial_chunk_leniency=true --expires=1h``` This should reduce visible 5xx while we get customers upgraded.
dave (product): Good. Track metrics: token streaming success rate, per-customer error rate, and rollback plan if we see other regressions.
raj (oncall-next): I'm taking over handoff at 10:15 UTC. Summary: elevated streaming 5xx due to combined proxy OOMs + model-worker slow tails + some client SDKs canceling mid-chunk. Mitigations: scaled gate-stream, routing fallback, proxy restarts, lenient parser toggle. Current status: error rate ~1.3% and trending down, impacted customers notified.
emma (oncall): Documenting actions in incident tracker and creating follow-up tasks: - postmortem to determine root cause of proxy OOMs and GC tuning for model-workers - enforcement plan for SDK upgrades / compatibility checks - telemetry add for chunk/frame-level error classification
lin a (sre): (typo correction) lina (sre): I'll own the OOM root cause - collecting pprof and node metrics.
ken (eng-runtime): I'll produce a small patch to add graceful-client-cancel path to runtime that returns 200+trailer instead of 502 mapping when upstream cancels within chunk window.
sara (support): Keeping customers updated; first-wave email sent.
emma (oncall): Handoff complete to raj. If anything spikes again ping @emma and @raj. Closing active page. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: SEV2 -> monitoring state. Actions logged.
